caption: The video captures a hazy gray sky above dark rooftops, with power lines slanting across the lower frame. The sun sits near the center as a bright white disc, flanked by two pale side glows at the same height. A faint circular band surrounds the sun, while the two side patches remain aligned with it throughout the clip. Thin cloud layers drift slowly across the sky, changing the brightness and texture around the halo without moving the sun or its side glows. The rooftops and wires shift slightly to one side as the view drifts, while the sky patterns keep evolving overhead. The visible scene presents a stable sun-dog display under moving cloud cover, with the halo and side glows holding their positions as the thin veil shifts slowly.
relations: Drifting thin cloud layers alter the brightness and texture surrounding the sun's halo.
A slight view drift shifts the dark rooftops and power lines across the frame.
The sun and flanking side glows persist in stable alignment while the cloud veil moves.
